Projects.title: Featured Projects
Projects.description: These are my most relevant and complete projects

items.title: Ask Room + Gemini AI
items.description: A full-stack project that enables the creation of knowledge rooms, where users can add text or audio content and, based on that context, other people can ask questions answered by an AI exclusively from the provided material.

items.title: Stock Forge
items.description: A monorepo project for managing products and raw materials. Forging a product consumes supplies, updates inventory, and affects other productions.

items.title: Marketplace Next.js
items.description: A modern application built to demonstrate a complete checkout flow with authentication, shopping cart, and multiple payment methods.

items.title: Next.js Saas RBAC
items.description: A multi-tenant SaaS with robust authentication and an authorization system based on RBAC (Role-Based Access Control). Built with best practices and monorepo architecture for maximum scalability and code reuse.

items.title: Habit Tracker
items.description: A habit tracking system. Add habits, configure the day of the week, track your progress, and keep data persisted in the database.

items.title: Microwave
items.description: An interactive microwave simulator with sounds and features faithful to the appliance.
